blocks.text: Like nouns, adjectives change according to case, number, and gender. An adjective has no inherent gender, so it changes its ending to suit the gender (and case and number) of the noun it's modifying. An adjective modifying a singular, feminine noun in the instrumental case, is itself in the singular, feminine, instrumental case.

However, when you look up an adjective in the dictionary, what do you see? You see the default, nominative, masculine, singular form. For a more thorough treatment of adjectives, see their dedicated page. For our purposes, we only need to know two things: all adjectives end in either **-ый**, **-ий**, or **-ой**, and conjugating adjectives is as simple as removing these endings and adding the new ones. The ending you add is the one that corresponds to the noun.

Adjectives modifying masculine nouns in the nominative case keep their default endings: 'new pencil' is **новый карандаш**. For feminine nouns, the adjective takes on the ending **-ая**: 'new book' is **новая книга**. For neuter nouns, the ending is **-ое**: 'new letter' is **новое письмо**.

Adjectives also change according to number, so when modifying a plural noun, regardless of gender, they have the ending **-ые**: 'new books' is **новые книги**. However, like nouns, they obey the 7-letter spelling rule.

As mentioned earlier, if the stem of a noun ends in **к**, **г**, **х**, **ш**, **щ**, **ж**, and **ч**, then different endings from usual apply. The same is true for adjectives. Adjectives such as **хороший** ('good'), **русский** ('Russian'), and **другой** ('different'), take on alternate endings to other adjectives. In the nominative case, this only affects plural adjectives: instead of **-ые**, these adjectives have the ending **-ие**.

In general, after these seven consonants, whenever you would normally see **ы** in an adjectival ending, you instead find **и**. This also applies to standard adjectival endings: after these seven letters, you always have the default ending **ий**. This can be useful in predicting or remembering the default endings of adjectives. Unlike nouns, adjectives are affected by a second spelling rule.

On top of the previous spelling rule, there's a second important rule: after the letters **ш, щ, ж, ч**, and **ц**, the first unstressed **о** in an ending becomes **е**. For nominative adjectives, this only affects neuter singular endings: we have **-ее** as the ending, not **-ое**.

An easy way to remember this is that four of the five letters are the 'hushes', **ш**, **щ**, **ж**, and **ч**, and these are also four letters from the seven-letter spelling rule. Few adjectives end in **цый**, so you don't have to worry about this so much. As such, almost all adjectives that follow this rule also follow the 7-letter rule: **хороший**, **хорошее письмо**, **хорошие письма**.

The final nuance with Russian adjectives are the adjectives that have the so-called 'soft ending': **-ний**, such as **синий** ('dark blue'). These adjectives don't fall into the above two spelling rules, but still take on the exceptional endings. These are covered more thoroughly on their own page, but in the nominative case they have only one unique ending: the feminine singular ending for these adjectives is **-яя**, not **-ая**. They also take on the alternate neuter and plural endings we learned for the seven- and five-letter spelling rules: **-ее** for neuter nouns, and **-ие** for plural nouns.
So, a summary of adjectival endings in the nominative case is as follows:

Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **хороший → хорошая** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with программа). Declines like хороший. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (местный, nom. pl.) жители называют эту реку "людоедом" и боятся её.
exercises.prompt: The locals call this river the "man-eater" and fear it.
exercises.why: **местный → местные** (nom. pl., agreeing with жители). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ые.

exercises.q: ___ (ручной, nom. sg. f.) работа ценится дорого.
exercises.why: **ручной → ручная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with работа). Declines like новый (the masculine nominative ends in -ой, not -ый). Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (гидравлический, nom. sg. f.) энергия приводит в движение колесо.
exercises.why: **гидравлический → гидравлическая** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with энергия). Declines like русский. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (контрольный, nom. sg. f.) вышка перестала отвечать.
exercises.why: **контрольный → контрольная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with вышка). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (французский, nom. sg. f.) культура продолжает пользоваться большим престижем.
exercises.prompt: French culture continues to enjoy great prestige.
exercises.why: **французский → французская** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with культура). Declines like русский. Nominative: the ending is -ая.
**человеческий → человеческая** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with натура). Declines like русский. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (всякий, nom. sg. f.) нация стремится увековечить себя.
exercises.prompt: Every nation seeks to perpetuate itself.
exercises.why: **всякий → всякая** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with нация). Declines like русский. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (тонкий, nom. sg. f.) кишка состоит из трёх частей.
exercises.prompt: The small intestine consists of three parts.
exercises.why: **тонкий → тонкая** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with кишка). Declines like русский. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: Торпеда - это ___ (подводный, nom. sg. f.) ракета.
exercises.prompt: A torpedo is an underwater missile.
exercises.why: **подводный → подводная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with ракета). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.
**верный → верная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with информация). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: Чья это ___ (книжный, nom. sg. f.) полка?
exercises.why: **книжный → книжная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with полка). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.
**многонациональный → многонациональная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with страна). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (кишечный, nom. sg. f.) флора влияет на психику.
exercises.why: **кишечный → кишечная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with флора). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (тёмный, nom. sg. f.) материя является невидимой.
exercises.why: **тёмный → темная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with материя). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (следующий, nom. sg. f.) пандемия может быть ещё хуже.
exercises.prompt: The next pandemic could be even worse.
exercises.why: **следующий → следующая** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with пандемия). Declines like хороший. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (икроножный, nom. sg. f.) мышца находится в задней нижней части ноги.
exercises.prompt: The calf muscle is located on the back of the lower leg.
exercises.why: **икроножный → икроножная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with мышца). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.
**вертикальный → вертикальная** (nom. sg. f., agreeing with линия). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ая.

exercises.q: ___ (храбрый, nom. sg. m.) пёс покусал вора.
exercises.prompt: The brave dog bit the thief.
exercises.why: **храбрый → храбрый** (nom. sg. m., agreeing with пёс). Declines like новый. Nominative: the ending is -ый.
